disciple_requests_leave.title: A Request to Wander
disciple_requests_leave.description: [initiator_name] approaches you with a formal bow. They wish to travel the Jianghu and seek advanced martial knowledge before returning.

opt_grant_leave.text: Grant them leave. Go and return wiser.

effects.text: The Sect Master granted my request to wander. I will not waste this chance.

opt_deny_leave.text: Deny the request. The sect needs them here.

effects.text: My request to wander was denied. I must suppress my restlessness.

wanderer_returns.title: The Wanderer Returns
wanderer_returns.description: [initiator_name] has returned from their journey through the Jianghu, carrying stories of distant sects and new techniques.

effects.text: I have returned from my travels, changed by what I experienced.

wandering_master_visits.title: A Grand Master Passes Through
wandering_master_visits.description: A renowned wandering master of the Jianghu has arrived at your sect's gates, seeking hospitality for the night. Their bearing speaks of tremendous cultivation.

opt_welcome_and_invite.text: Welcome them lavishly and invite them to exchange pointers.

opt_turn_away.text: Turn them away politely. Strangers bring risks.

effects.text: I turned away the wandering master. My sect's secrets must be guarded.

wandering_master_departs.title: Parting Words
wandering_master_departs.description: The wandering master prepares to depart. Before leaving, they offer a parting gift for your hospitality — a technique scroll or a personal blessing.

effects.text: A wandering grandmaster bestowed a technique scroll upon [initiator_sect_name].

chance_encounter_rival.title: A Face from the Past
chance_encounter_rival.description: [initiator_name] is travelling through the mountain roads when they cross paths with a rival they once wronged — or were wronged by. The air between them is electric.

opt_challenge.text: Draw weapons. Settle the old score now.

effects.text: I met an old enemy on the road. We settled our score with steel.

opt_parley.text: Stop and talk. Perhaps old wounds can be eased.

effects.text: I met an old rival on the road and chose words over weapons.
